scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.storm: The storm grows thicker and thicker. Past three blocks, all you can see is white.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.kwijt: Sniff... sniff... nothing but snow. I can't find the way, nyeg.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.wolf: And then there she stands, on Wolf Rock. A white wolf guh. She glows softly, like a little star.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.boris: A regular guh would never make it. But a Baltoguh...
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.half: Half guh, half wolf... and that's just right. Howl along!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_balto.klaart: The storm settles down. And look: there are the posts again!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.titel: Day 45: The Night of the Bang
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.dag45: Day 45. Thunder rumbled over Clone Island. And in the clone tank... something bubbled.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.krak: CRACK! A split shot right across the glass.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.ogen: And in the pink nibble juice, two purple eyes opened.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.wie: Who am I... and where are my nibbles?
scene.guhs.oudescenes_mewtwo.begon: And then... then it all came back to me. Nyeg!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_ohana.nacht: When everyone's asleep, 626-guh sits all by himself at the campfire. With the picture book.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_ohana.erbij: Scoot over, little chonk. I'll sit with you.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_ohana.citaat: Ohana means family. Family means nobody gets left behind... or forgotten. Nyeg.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_ohana.sterren: And above Guhwai'i, a thousand stars watched along. Nobody forgotten. Nobody.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.drie: A crystal, a golden nibble and a feather. That was all the Snuggleheart needed.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.wolken: High above the little chapel, the clouds slid open...
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.straal: ...and through the heart window fell a beam of light, right onto the heart.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.bonk: Thump... thump. The Snuggleheart beats again!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.vahoeg: WAHOOG, it's beating! For you, and for all your guhs waiting for you up in the clouds.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_hemel.nooit: From now on, nobody ever has to truly say goodbye again.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_grill.blokje: One Fire Starter Cube in the grill coal frame. Tsss...
scene.guhs.oudescenes_grill.loopt: ...and off runs the little flame, all around the frame!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_grill.ruik: Smell that? Cheese frying sauce, all the way from the other side! Nyeg nyeg nyeg.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_grill.verte: And far away, on top of a charred guh statue, someone in a pointy hat stood watching.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_grill.begonnen: Hm. The fire is burning again. Then it has begun, nyeg.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.tok: Tap, tap, TAP! The very last roof fluff is on.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.vlag: And there it flutters: the topping-out flag!
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.dak: WAHOOG! With a roof on, it's finally a real little house.
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.wie: Now it just needs someone to live in it... Nyeg?
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.trippel: And who comes pitter-pattering along, with a teeny-tiny suitcase full of nibbles?
scene.guhs.oudescenes_timmer.knus: The first little resident. Little house, little guh. Cozy!
